_todo: OQ-GFX-LOOK: sky, light, fog, bloom, grading, weather and the three variants (dusk, night, storm; DESIGN.md:8) are presentation trials. Which variant a match shows (fixed, or rotated by the match seed) is Shibi's call; nothing here changes rules, sight ranges or bots.
_base_note: The base look is dusk. Its sun, ambient light and exposure stay in data/art_greybox.json "environment" and its fog and shadow numbers in data/art_astra.json "environment" (the keys the lighting tests read); the sky, post and weather numbers are here. A variant overrides any of them: "light" = art_greybox environment keys, "fog" = art_astra environment keys, "sky", "post", "wet", "weather".

rotation._note: enabled: the match seed picks the variant from by_seed (seed modulo the list length) when a match begins; off: every match shows "variant".

_m2w1_note: M2W1 (OQ-ART-WORLD, placeholders): dusk is now a clear late golden hour; the old dusk (the base blocks with no override) stays as dusk_deep for comparison (not in rotation.by_seed). Optional keys (absent = engine default, the look before M2W1): light ambient_source color|sky|bg, ambient_sky_contribution, reflected_light_source; fog tonemap_white, fog_height, fog_height_density, shadow_blur, shadow_bias, shadow_normal_bias, shadow_opacity, shadow_fade_start, shadow_blend_splits; post glow_hdr_scale, glow_levels; sky cloud_light_step, cloud_light_gain, cloud_light_mix, cloud_base_color, cloud_base, cloud2_cover, cloud2_scale, cloud2_stretch, cloud2_offset, cloud2_color, cloud2_opacity, horizon_haze, horizon_haze_width, horizon_haze_color, horizon_haze_sun_color (scripts/visual/greybox_art.gd, sky_astra.gdshader).

light._astraB: M2W1 astraB (F3): a late golden hour: sun 13.5 degrees up (azimuth unchanged), gold not orange; a cool, lower ambient so the shadow sides stay blue-violet and model the forms; exposure and white re-balanced so lit travertine sits below the top of the curve.

night._astraB: M2W1 astraB (F9): a low moon (22 degrees, azimuth unchanged) rim-lights the walls and leaves the flat ground quiet; less ambient; the haze is darker and reaches far (no uniform blue field); the world's own glow (energy lines, door lamps, beacons) x glow_gain with bloom from a lower threshold.
night._r2b: M2W1 r2b (C4; OQ-ART-WORLD placeholders): the emissive accents carry the frame: glow_gain 2.2 -> 7.0, bloom threshold 0.85 -> 1.0 (moonlit stone no longer blooms, only the accents), intensity 0.9 -> 1.1, glow_levels weighted to the wide levels (5-7) so a thin band 300 m away spreads into a visible halo; the far ridges sink into the dark fog (art_backdrop.json tints).
night._ground_note: M2W1 r2b: ground detail uniforms for night only (WorldSurface.set_ground_look): the moonlit limestone crown of the citadel hill one step darker, so the summit's glow, not the hill, is the brightest mass.

storm._astraB: M2W1 astraB (F9): rain-dark ground and stone with a restrained, varied sheen (art_materials.json wet, art_ground_detail.json puddle_* and wet_rough_vary), the sky in darker and lighter cloud layers, the emissive accents carrying the entrances (glow_gain); haze darker than before and reaching farther.
storm._r2b: M2W1 r2b (C4; OQ-ART-WORLD placeholders): glow_gain 1.8 -> 3.0, bloom threshold 0.95 -> 1.0 and the same wide glow_levels as night, so the gates, towers and summit lead the grey frame.

weather_kinds._note: Weather follows the camera and is drawn only when the graphics preset has art_weather_enabled. Counts are particles alive at once.

forward_plus._note: OQ-GFX-RENDERER: numbers for the effects only the Forward+ renderer draws (screen-space reflections, ambient occlusion and indirect light, volumetric fog). They do nothing on the Mobile renderer; the preset's fx_* switches turn each on.

compatibility._note: W1b (OQ-WEB-GFX-PARITY): Compatibility-only guesses for Shibi. Environment properties are applied after the base look, with variant values taking precedence.

environment._note: OQ-WEB-GFX-SKYLIGHT: reduce the brightness of moonlit paving and retain the fill on shaded stone.
OQ-WEB-GFX-SKYLIGHT: match the Mobile wet ground with reduced exposure and ambient fill.

shafts._note: Sun shafts are a few see-through quads that hang in the air along the sun's direction at the places listed (additive, no depth read). Drawn only with art_shafts_enabled and when the variant's sun is strong enough (min_sun_energy).
